study type: Phase 1 dose-escalation trial (human), In vivo study (rabbit model), In vitro study
exposure: sub-endometrial injection of human embryonic stem cell-derived immunity-and-matrix-regulatory cells (IMRCs)
cohort: The human study involved 18 patients with refractory moderate-to-severe intrauterine adhesion (IUA).
finding: High-dose sub-endometrial IMRC injection promoted angiogenesis, reduced uterine scarring, and improved pregnancy outcomes in patients with refractory IUA, with no safety concerns observed over 3 years.
